Definition: Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Sharezer or Sherezer = "prince of fire"; 1) son of king Sennacherib of Assyria and murderer of his father; 2) an Israelite whom the people sent to the house of God to pray in the time of the prophet Zechariah and king Darius
